description: Build an export quotation price from unit cost, markup and shipment costs: totals and per-unit prices under EXW, FCA, FOB/FCA terminal, CFR/CPT, CIF/CIP, DAP, DPU and DDP, with the insurance premium (110% basis), import duty and VAT, and for each rule a link that opens Triplicate's generator with a proforma invoice at that price.

costs.description: Shipment totals in the same currency (omit what does not apply)

destination_charges.description: Destination terminal charges and delivery to the named place

inland_to_port.description: Transport to the port, airport or terminal

insurance_rate_percent.description: Cargo insurance rate in %; premium = rate x 110% x CIF/CIP value

main_freight.description: Sea or air freight to the destination port/airport

origin_terminal.description: Terminal handling and loading at origin

packing_loading.description: Export packing and loading at the seller's premises

duty_basis.description: Customs value basis: cif (EU, UK, most countries) or fob (US, Canada, Australia)

language.description: Language of the generator page the proforma links open

mode.description: sea: FOB/CFR/CIF (loaded on board at a port); any: containers handed over at a terminal, air or road: FCA/CPT/CIP

name: calculate_export_price
title: Export price under each Incoterms rule
